outputs.name: EMAIL_CODE_LENGTH
outputs.description: The length of the email proof code, fixed at 8 characters by the constant in HubAuthValues.ts. It is declared with const, so the value cannot change at runtime.

outputs.name: NATIVE_AUDIENCE
outputs.description: The audience string 'harness-desktop' defined in HubAuthValues.ts. NativeAuthorization.audience is typed as this constant, so that field can only hold this value.

outputs.name: NATIVE_ACTION
outputs.description: The action string 'native-session' defined in HubAuthValues.ts and re-exported by accounts-access/HubAuth.types.ts. No type in these three files references it, so this unit does not show where it applies.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: The error HubAuth.authorizeRepository throws, according to its doc comment, which also says it re-proves GitHub admin and installation access on every call. AuthFailure is not declared in these three files, and the comment does not state when it is thrown.
